Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
On VTES-L, Michael Kaszubski wrote:
> 1. I have read that only one card/effect may be used to get an additional
> strike.

That is correct.

> Is the special ability of Jacko an effect (meaning he cannot play
> additional strikes)?

It is, but he also has explicit card text saying that his effect doesn't
prevent him from using another.

> 2. Can a Methuselah burn a vote card to gain a vote during a Blood Hunt?

Yes. Each Methuselah can use up to one Political Action card during any
referendum to gain a vote.

> 3. Can a vampire play a "prevent all" card to play a card requiring
> inflicting more damage on the opponent?

Yes, so long as the opposing minion doesn't also prevent all of his damage.
